_comment: Temporary trust (owner decision 2026-11-11): UNSIGNED packs whose source starts with a rule's 'match' are accepted without --allow-unsigned until the rule's 'until' date. Read by _classify_pack_signature (npdev_cli.py) after the app's own npdev-trust.json; an app in mode 'enforce' still refuses unsigned packs; a signed pack is never affected. Each pack accepted this way is recorded in npdev.lock as signature.acceptedBy = 'trust-defaults:<rule id>'. After 'until' the file grants nothing.

trustedUnsignedSources.reason: Owner decision 2026-11-11: packs are not signed yet; accept unsigned packs from the owner's own NPR so a model made by a browser AI can import NPR packs. Replace with signed packs (pack sign/verify already exist) before this date.
